name: print-social-purple-print-brand-promo-post-quartet
title: Purple print-brand promo set with product cards and glass panels
whatItIs: Four purple gradient posts for a printing company: one with a hand forming an OK sign over a map of Africa, three with translucent panels holding product images (rollup banner, polo, calendars, flag banner, umbrella) and labels.
whatItMeans: Bold and commercial yet neat; glass panels present products like a catalogue.
techniques: Show products inside frosted glass panels on a gradient.
Use a hand gesture cut-out as the hero for the brand message.
Repeat a two-panel layout for product sets.
Include logo and CTA bar in each post.

vocabulary.definition: A translucent frosted rectangle over a gradient.
A post showing several products with labels.
A hand pose cut out as a symbol.
A country or continent silhouette used as graphic.
